2.
The learned Advocate appearing for the Petitioner stated that he has instructions to unconditionally withdraw the above Writ Petition.
3. In these circumstances, the above Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
No order as to costs.
4. This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.
